description: This file defines the IgnoredErrors class, which manages boolean flags representing different types of errors or issues to be ignored in spreadsheet cell processing within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: IgnoredErrors
classes.description: A class that encapsulates various error flags to be ignored during spreadsheet cell processing, with setters and getters for each error type.

methods.name: setNumberStoredAsText
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore errors related to numbers stored as text.

methods.name: getNumberStoredAsText
methods.description: Returns whether the error for numbers stored as text is ignored.

methods.name: setFormula
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore formula-related errors.

methods.name: getFormula
methods.description: Returns whether formula errors are ignored.

methods.name: setTwoDigitTextYear
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore errors related to two-digit text year formats.

methods.name: getTwoDigitTextYear
methods.description: Returns whether two-digit text year errors are ignored.

methods.name: setEvalError
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore evaluation errors.

methods.name: getEvalError
methods.description: Returns whether evaluation errors are ignored.
